verdict.rationale: Calendly's own marketing states it can charge upfront for meetings, and its pricing page lists Stripe and PayPal connections, which covers collecting payment at booking for paid sessions. The evidence is only brief marketing-level claims with no detailed setup documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the booking-time payment flow (refunds, plan requirements, currency handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration that payment is collected at the moment of booking.

support.subject: As a founder, I can collect payment (e.g. via Stripe) at the moment of booking for paid sessions

citations.quote: Charge upfront for meetings, sell packages, and send invoices with payment features that make it easy to get paid.
